{{Top|leg}}
A '''"polwocz"''' was a term given to [[Infiltration]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who were in deep cover, intended to remain undetected for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] if necessary, before striking in one devastating blow. The name was taken from the [[polwocz]] creature from the [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]].
